subject: Mutual Action Plan — replay window & capacity-sizing coordination
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Johnson <sara.johnson@fintechai.com>, ops-lead@fintechai.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 15:08:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo: MAP milestone for traffic replay & sizing — initial plan

Hi Sara / FinTech AI team,

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Per our mutual action plan, the next milestone is a traffic replay (peak QPS validation) so we can size Dedicated capacity and validate latency tail behavior under your peak profile. I put together a short draft schedule and a manifest for the replay that we can iterate on — attaching the MAP draft and a CSV with the replay manifest.

Proposed test windows (all times UTC):
- Option A: Tue 2027-04-20 08:00–12:00 (preferred for Redwood infra team)
- Option B: Thu 2027-04-22 14:00–18:00

Initial sizing assumption (very rough):
- Target sustained QPS: 2,500
- Peak bursts to plan for: 6,000 QPS for 2–5 minute bursts
- Working capacity ask: 8 x A100-equivalent for the run (we'll confirm exact SKUs after we finalize manifest and sequence lengths)

Ask items:
1) Please confirm which window (A or B) works for your ops team and whether you need a different timezone.
2) Confirm point of contact for in-test log access and throttling decisions (ops-lead@fintechai.com looks like the right contact; let me know if someone else should be on call).
3) Any changes to the manifest (we used sample traffic from your staging replay; see traffic_replay_manifest.csv attached).

I'll hold the preferred slot tentatively for 3 business days. Marissa / Neha — marking for support on runbook, readiness checklist and to finalize capacity assumptions.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: MAP_DRAFT_v2.pdf (MAP draft), traffic_replay_manifest.csv (replay trace list)

From: Sara Johnson <sara.johnson@fintechai.com>

Cc: ops-lead@fintechai.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 09:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MAP milestone for traffic replay & sizing — initial plan

Thanks Diego — this looks good. A couple of quick clarifications from our side: 

- Option A (Apr 20 morning UTC) is workable for our SRE team, but we'd prefer a later start in local time (we're US/Pacific); could we shift to 10:00–14:00 UTC instead?
- Our peak profile is slightly higher than the numbers in your manifest — our production peak is 3,400 sustained QPS with 8,500 QPS short bursts for 1–3 minutes. The replay manifest you attached is based on staging traces; I'll flag which traces are prod-like in the CSV and send an updated version by Tue.
- For in-test access, please loop in me (sara.johnson@fintechai.com) and our on-call ops lead (ops-lead@fintechai.com).

Also: can you outline what the required Dedicated capacity contract minimum is for the run if we need to spin reserved for the test? We want to understand potential short-term cost implications.

Appreciate it — Sara
Sara Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering | FinTech AI
sara.johnson@fintechai.com

Subject: Re: Post-demo: MAP milestone for traffic replay & sizing — initial plan

Thanks Sara — noted on the higher peak numbers. Two quick points from the Redwood ops/CS side: 

1) Capacity sizing: based on the updated peak (3.4k sustained, 8.5k bursts), our preliminary recommendation is 12 x A100-equivalent nodes with 4 reserved for burst headroom. That gives a comfortable margin for KV cache and embedding-heavy requests. We'll run a small calibration micro-test at 50% peak before the full replay to validate latency and memory pressure.

2) Contract/minimum for Dedicated: we can offer a short-term reserved pool for a 1-week commitment for test runs; estimate will depend on exact SKUs. For a 12-node A100-equivalent reserved pool the temporary charge would be quoted as an addendum — I'll coordinate with finance and include a ballpark in the MAP doc by Tue EOD.

Operational asks / runbook items I need from FinTech AI before the pre-test: 
- Finalized replay manifest (CSV) with annotated traces labeled prod-like
- Confirmation of the single point of contact for throttling decisions during the run (ops-lead@fintechai.com)
- Access to a read-only logs endpoint and test account API key for replay (we'll provide instructions for minimal permissions)

I'll schedule a 30-min pre-test readiness call the day before the run (suggested: Apr 19 09:00 UTC if we lock Apr 20 run). Diego — can you take lead to lock the calendar with Sara?

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
